result.markdown: --- title: "[Graph.bipartite_projection()]{.doc-object-name .doc-function .doc-label .doc-label-method}" body-classes: doc-api-page doc-py-api-page shift-heading-level-by: 0 toc-depth: 3 page-navigation: false html-table-processing: none --- ::: {.doc-subject} Project a bipartite graph onto one of its partitions. ::: ::: {.doc-usage-source} Usage [Source](https://github.com/rich-iannone/edgecase/blob/main/python/edgecase/graph.py#L5772-L5852){target="_blank" rel="noopener"} ::: ::: {.doc-signature .doc-Kind.FUNCTION} ```python Graph.bipartite_projection(which=0) ``` ::: ::: {.doc-text} ![Bipartite projection](/assets/graphs/bipartite-projection.light.svg){.lightbox fig-alt="A bipartite graph with A, B, C, D on top and E, F below; E, in the accent color, is joined to A, B, C and F, in teal, to B, C, D. Projecting onto the top side joins two nodes when they share a neighbor below, weighted by how many they share: A-B and A-C share only E (accent), B-D and C-D share only F (teal), and B-C shares both, so it is a plain edge of weight 2." width="100%"} Two nodes in the chosen partition become connected if they share at least one neighbor in the other partition. Edge weights equal the number of shared neighbors. ::: ## Parameters {.doc-parameters} ::: {.doc-definition-items} [which]{.doc-parameter-name}[:]{.doc-parameter-annotation-sep} [int]{.doc-parameter-annotation} [=]{.doc-parameter-default-sep .op} [[0]{.dv}]{.doc-parameter-default} : Which partition to project onto: `0` or `1` (as returned by ``bipartite_sets()``). ::: ## Returns {.doc-returns} ::: {.doc-definition-items} [Graph]{.doc-parameter-annotation} : A new graph containing only the nodes of the chosen partition, with edges weighted by shared-neighbor counts. ::: ## Raises {.doc-raises} ::: {.doc-definition-items} [ValueError]{.doc-parameter-annotation} : If the graph is not bipartite, or if `which` is not 0 or 1. ::: ## Examples {.doc-examples} Project a gene-disease network onto genes; genes become connected if they share diseases: ::: {#e4bab50f .cell execution_count=1} ``` {.python .cell-code} import edgecase as ec graph = ( ec.Graph() .add_node(label="Gene1") .add_node(label="Gene2") .add_node(label="Gene3") .add_node(label="Disease1") .add_node(label="Disease2") .add_edge("Gene1", "Disease1") .add_edge("Gene2", "Disease1") .add_edge("Gene2", "Disease2") .add_edge("Gene3", "Disease2") ) set_a, set_b = graph.bipartite_sets() # Find which set contains the genes gene1_id = graph.get_id_from_label("Gene1") gene_set = 0 if gene1_id in set_a else 1 projection = graph.bipartite_projection(which=gene_set) projection.count_nodes(), projection.count_edges() ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-display execution_count=1} ``` (3, 2) ``` ::: :::
